bands.does_not_proceed: mean diff > 0 but the CI includes 0, or per-game gain < +0.05: the round closes with a complete per-decision result
bands.proceed: game-clustered CI lower bound > 0 AND per-game gain >= +0.05, per-game gain = primary mean diff x LIVE overturns/game
bands.tripwires: per-game gain > +0.25 OR primary mean diff > +0.20: L1/L2-form impeachment checks run BEFORE the read is reported

comment: Single source for Stage 2's pinned parameters. The games runner builds TEACHER_TUPLE_JSON from teacher_tuple verbatim; the L3 runner pins the label driver from label_tuple; the analyzers audit every stamped row against this file (the second placement, stage1 pattern). horizon_value is in OUTCOME units (win +1, loss -1): -1 prices a drawn world as a loss; the analyzer reads' draw prices are in SCORE units (score = (outcome+1)/2), so outcome 0 is the 0.5-equivalent.

fleet_reference.draw_scored_outcomes: teacher 216.0 (173W/86D/141L) vs raw 213.0 (163W/100D/137L), round-7 fleet, 400 paired games
